_et ponet eam in umbram mortis_ (Clementina, Weber/Gryson) – and he will place it in the shadow of death. – According to Gryson, Jerome wrote _umbramortis_ as one word; in translation: “and will place it in Deathshadow”; see the textual note above, on Isa 9:2. Roger Gryson: Barachie et la prophétisse. _Revue biblique_ 96.3 (1989) 321–337, at pp. 335–336.
